proposalSections.title: Welcome to the LoneTree proposal experience
proposalSections.narrative: A guided view of how Salt Basin can identify, validate, and operationalize hidden value across portfolio revenue and evidence flows.

proposalSections.title: The Monetary River System
proposalSections.narrative: Commercial, operational, financial, and evidence flows are reconstructed as one governed semantic system.

proposalSections.title: One governed molecule, many projections
proposalSections.narrative: The same finding, evidence, recommendation, and outcome can render in the proposal, dashboard, Orbit, implementation plan, and board output.

proposalSections.title: A bounded diagnostic, not a transformation program
proposalSections.narrative: Phase 1 reconstructs the relevant flows, tests priority exceptions, quantifies validated opportunities, and defines the recovery path.

proposalSections.title: Where value may be hidden
proposalSections.narrative: Illustrative scenarios show how pricing, usage, renewal, billing, cash, revenue, and evidence failures may create recoverable value or risk.

proposalSections.title: Every claim exposes its evidence
proposalSections.narrative: Benchmarks, assumptions, scenario logic, confidence, applicability, and limitations remain visible and traceable.

proposalSections.title: LoneTree Phase 1 proposal
proposalSections.narrative: The proposal defines inputs, tests, deliverables, responsibilities, timing, and decision gates for an initial portfolio-company diagnostic.

proposalSections.title: From diagnostic to repeatable capability
proposalSections.narrative: Validated findings move through recovery, prevention, reconciliation, and portfolio scaling.

proposalSections.title: Choose the next state
proposalSections.narrative: Proceed, request a discussion, request revision, or decline while preserving the evidence and proposal state.

proposalSections.title: Persistent access to the engagement
proposalSections.narrative: The workspace retains the proposal, decision, evidence, and later diagnostic outputs.

salesNarrativeScenes.businessGoal: Show a tailored portfolio operating experience, not a generic software demo.
Show commercial, operational, financial, and evidence flows converging.
Introduce leakage as broken handoffs, missing evidence, and disconnected definitions.
Explain reconstruction, semantic normalization, reconciliation, and exception testing.
Present distinct opportunity categories with exposure bases and confidence.
Expose source, date, confidence, applicability, and limitations.
Present deliverables, timing, responsibilities, and decision gates.
Show recovery, prevention, reconciliation, and portfolio scaling.
Capture proceed, discussion, revision, or decline.

diagnosticModules.name: Commercial Baseline
diagnosticModules.objective: Establish revenue, contract, renewal, usage, billing, cash, and reporting baselines.
diagnosticModules.coreTests: Coverage, completeness, source-of-truth, trend and reconciliation tests

diagnosticModules.name: Contract-to-Billing Integrity
diagnosticModules.objective: Test whether executed economics are represented correctly downstream.
diagnosticModules.coreTests: Term, price, quantity, discount, date and amendment comparisons

diagnosticModules.name: Usage Integrity
diagnosticModules.objective: Trace usage events through rating, billing, and reporting.
diagnosticModules.coreTests: Missing, duplicate, late, unpriced and mis-tiered usage tests

diagnosticModules.name: Billing-to-Cash
diagnosticModules.objective: Trace invoices, collections, credits, refunds, and cash application.
diagnosticModules.coreTests: Invoice aging, dispute, credit, refund, unapplied cash and timing tests

diagnosticModules.name: Revenue-to-GL Integrity
diagnosticModules.objective: Reconcile revenue schedules and subledger outputs to the GL.
diagnosticModules.coreTests: Subledger-to-GL, invoice-to-AR and journal trace tests

diagnosticModules.name: Customer and Renewal Health
diagnosticModules.objective: Connect contract economics, service signals, and renewal risk.
diagnosticModules.coreTests: Renewal coverage, churn signal, entitlement and service-risk tests

diagnosticModules.name: AI and Data Readiness
diagnosticModules.objective: Assess semantic coverage, lineage, permissions, and agent readiness.
diagnosticModules.coreTests: Definition, lineage, evidence, access and freshness tests

diagnosticModules.name: QoE and Exit Readiness
diagnosticModules.objective: Identify evidence gaps and recurring-quality risks.
diagnosticModules.coreTests: Source trace, recurring quality, adjustment and supportability tests

diagnosticModules.name: Portfolio Repeatability
diagnosticModules.objective: Determine which mappings and tests can scale across portfolio companies.
diagnosticModules.coreTests: Commonality, portability, control and configuration tests

evidenceItems.claimOrAssumption: Revenue leakage is often systemic while automated assurance capabilities remain limited.
evidenceItems.applicability: Supports plausibility of cross-functional leakage mechanisms.
evidenceItems.limitation: Does not establish a LoneTree or portfolio-company leakage rate.

evidenceItems.claimOrAssumption: Connecting contract and financial management is associated with improved contract value performance.
evidenceItems.limitation: Association is not a guaranteed recovery result.

evidenceItems.claimOrAssumption: Data silos and insufficient AI-ready data constrain operating value.
evidenceItems.applicability: Supports semantic and AI readiness module.

evidenceItems.claimOrAssumption: Material weaknesses remain common in public-company readiness contexts.
evidenceItems.applicability: Supports evidence and control readiness framing.
evidenceItems.limitation: IPO population is not identical to PE portfolio companies.

evidenceItems.claimOrAssumption: Seeded opportunity ranges are illustrative and not client estimates.
evidenceItems.applicability: Applies to all MVP opportunity values.
evidenceItems.limitation: Must be replaced or validated during Phase 1.

evidenceItems.claimOrAssumption: LoneTree will initially evaluate one selected portfolio-company diagnostic.
evidenceItems.limitation: Final company and data availability are not yet confirmed.

evidenceItems.claimOrAssumption: Existing Salt Basin runtime already supports core entity, journey, highway, projection, security, and action patterns.
evidenceItems.applicability: Allows this package to remain a bounded delta.
evidenceItems.limitation: Workbook terms must be mapped to actual codebase names.

opportunityScenarios.mechanism: Contracted renewal escalator not applied downstream.
Temporary or conditional discounts persist beyond authorized term.
Usage events are missing, duplicated, late, or rated to the wrong tier.
Renewal risk is not visible early enough to protect recurring revenue.
Executed amendments are not reflected in billing configuration.
Credits, disputes, and unapplied cash delay or obscure cash conversion.
Revenue schedules or manual journals do not retain complete source lineage.
AI is applied to fragmented definitions and incomplete evidence lineage.
Recurring-quality evidence cannot be reproduced efficiently for QoE or exit.
opportunityScenarios.exposureBasis: Enterprise value or transaction cost basis
